01-cinematic-3d.name: Cinematic 3D (Pixar-inspired)
01-cinematic-3d.summary: Soft global-light look, glossy highlights, warm subsurface, no outlines, emotional faces.

02-dynamic-3d.name: Dynamic 3D (DreamWorks-inspired)
02-dynamic-3d.summary: Stockier, wider build, bigger head, stronger contrast and specular punch for exaggerated attitude.

03-fairytale.name: Fairytale (Disney-inspired)
03-fairytale.summary: Graceful taller build, large sparkling eyes, pastel jewel palette, soft magical lighting.

04-hyperreal.name: Hyperrealistic 3D Cartoon
04-hyperreal.summary: Natural fur tones with micro surface texture, sheen and deep subsurface; filmic, low-saturation grade.

05-cute-baby.name: Cute Baby Cartoon
05-cute-baby.summary: Round oversized head, huge eyes, tiny body, pastel palette, very soft bright light.

06-anime.name: Anime
06-anime.summary: Hard two-tone cel shading, crisp highlight, thin dark linework, saturated sky-blue world.

07-chibi.name: Chibi
07-chibi.summary: Head bigger than the body, stubby limbs, bold outlines and candy colours.

08-clay.name: Clay Animation
08-clay.summary: Matte plasticine with thumb-pressed surface variation, no outlines, warm tabletop light.

09-storybook.name: 2D Storybook
09-storybook.summary: Two painted tones with paper grain and warm brown ink, like a picture-book illustration.

10-comedy.name: Comedy Cartoon
10-comedy.summary: Squat wide bodies, huge eyes and heads for big reactions, loud primary colours.

11-animal-adventure.name: Animal Adventure
11-animal-adventure.summary: Anthropomorphic animals with natural fur texture and explorer gear tones, warm golden light.

12-miniature.name: Miniature 3D World
12-miniature.summary: Toy-like painted surfaces, macro tilt-shift depth of field and saturated miniature sets.

13-scifi.name: Futuristic Sci-Fi
13-scifi.summary: Dark metallic bodies with glowing neon edges, cool night lighting and a neon-teal grade.

14-fantasy.name: Fantasy Adventure
14-fantasy.summary: Enchanted-forest jewel tones, violet rim light and a glowing magical atmosphere.

15-educational.name: Educational Cartoon
15-educational.summary: Clear friendly shapes, primary colours, even classroom light and readable outlines.

distinctness.note: signature = (mean saturation, luminance spread/64, texture/10) of the 5 characters; shape differences (proportions, outlines) are not in this number
